title: Compacting the history away, and what a read below it gets
note: Compaction is a log entry like any other, so every member applies it and every member refuses the same reads afterwards — a follower that still answers here has not applied it. The stage does this while one member is cut off, which leaves the leader with no entries old enough to send it and nothing to offer but the state itself. The revision numbers here are the reference's; a stage computes the compaction point from the header its own writes came back with.
